]

for b_start, b_end in blocked_intervals:
    solver.add(z3.Or(start + 30 <= b_start, start >= b_end))

if solver.check() == z3.sat:
    model = solver.model()
    start_time = model[start].as_long()
    day = "Monday"
    start_hh = start_time // 60
    start_mm = start_time % 60
